Engineering Services

Precision engineering supporting advanced motion technology.

Alongside development of our proprietary slotless axial-flux BLDC platform, we help teams design and prototype advanced electromechanical products, from precision assemblies to motor controls and compact power electronics.

PROJECT SCOPES

Our Engineering Capabilities

01 / SERVICE

Mechanical Design & CAD

Precision housings, bearing supports, rotating assemblies, motor mounts, and mechanical interfaces.

Typical deliverables

CAD models, assembly drawings, and interface documentation.

02 / SERVICE

Electrical Engineering & Motor Controls

BLDC controls, PCB design, sensor integration, firmware, motor characterization, and electronic system architecture.

Typical deliverables

Scoped schematics, firmware, integration notes, or bench test results.

03 / SERVICE

Electromechanical System Development

Integrate actuators, electronics, sensors, and mechanical packaging for precision motion systems, robotics fixtures, and prototype assemblies.

Typical deliverables

Assembly CAD, interface definitions, and a prototype build plan.

04 / SERVICE

Design for Manufacturing

Review geometry, materials, tolerances, and inspection needs before releasing a design for CNC machining.

Typical deliverables

Manufacturing drawings, material specifications, and inspection requirements.

05 / SERVICE

Thermal Management

Design heat paths, enclosures, and mounting interfaces for motor systems, power electronics, and compact assemblies.

Typical deliverables

Enclosure CAD, thermal design notes, and manufacturing drawings.

06 / SERVICE

Prototype Manufacturing Support

Source prototype parts, coordinate machining and PCB fabrication through external partners, and support component integration.

Typical deliverables

Sourcing and assembly plans with agreed inspection and delivery requirements.

HOW THE WORK IS DELIVERED

From Engineering Concept to Functional Prototype

Our services run alongside our motor research and development. Each project starts with a defined scope, deliverables, and review points.

Led by Absolute Operations

Mechanical and electrical design, controls, thermal management, integration planning, and manufacturing documentation.

Coordinated through partners

Machining, PCB fabrication and assembly, and specialist inspection as needed. We identify partner responsibilities and costs before work begins. Our in-house CNC capability is planned.
